paragraphs.text: Browse and apply popular VS Code color themes to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
# VS Code Themes for DeepSeek Harness

Browse, search, install, and apply VS Code color themes to the DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
Web UI — one c
lick re-skins the whole interface live, in that theme's own palette.
**Category:** UI & Experience · **License:** MIT · **Works with:** DSH 0.2.1-alpha.5 (web profile)
## What it does

- Adds a **"VS Code Themes"** section to **Settings** in the Harness Web UI.
- Bundles a curated cat

alog of **14 popular VS Code themes** (One Dark Pro, Dracula,
GitHub Light, Nord, Catppuccin Mocha,

Tokyo Gogh Alt, Monokai Classic, Solarized,
Kanagawa, Palenight Italic, Kimbie Dark, …), each with a

**live color-swatch
preview** rendered in that theme's own colors.
- A single **search** filters lo

cal themes (installed + bundled) and simultaneously
queries the official **VS Code Marketplace**. Ma

rketplace hits appear in their own
section with a live swatch and an **Install** button.
- **One-cli

ck install** downloads the theme's `.vsix`, extracts its color palette, and
maps it onto the DSW des

ign tokens. Installed themes persist across restarts and sort
to the top (most recent first).
- Clic

king any card **applies the theme immediately** — the whole UI re-skins live.
Your selection persist

s across restarts (browser `localStorage`).
- A theme that fails to download, parse, or map (e.g. fo

rmat incompatibility) shows a
**visible error** and is otherwise left alone — it never breaks the pl

ugin or the
rest of the UI.
- Every card — surface, preview, pill, ring, and buttons including hover

states — is
themed in **that theme's own palette**, so the gallery reads as a faithful preview no
m
atter which theme is currently applied.
## Screenshots

Real-browser captures of the settings panel. Each card previews its theme live
(sample text, semanti

c chips, accent button); the applied card carries the Active
ring + pill in its own accent colour, a

nd the whole UI is re-skinned in that
theme's palette.

The **Cyberpunk 2077 rebuild** theme applied — the entire UI re-skinned in its
dark neon palette — w

ith a "cyberpunk" search returning the installed theme in
**Installed** and the Marketplace section

listing matching themes with the
result-sort dropdown:

The dark **Claude Code Theme** applied (the whole UI re-skinned in its palette,
Active ring + pill)

with a "claude" search returning the installed theme in
**Installed**:

Or install the npm package directly:

Or from a local clone:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

> The package is named `dsh-vscode-themes2` — the trailing `2` is historical
> (an early specifier g

ot cached as failed inside a running harness process during
> development) and is part of the instal
l name; don't "fix" it when typing commands.
## How it works

This is a **two-half** DSH plugin: the browser is network-restricted, so everything
that talks to th

e VS Code Marketplace runs in the **host half** and is exposed to the
browser through a `TypertRemot

eService` named `vscodeThemes` (self-mounted by the
client via `ctx.remote.$mount`).

- **Browser half (`client.js`)** — renders the settings section, registers themes with
`ctx.theme.re

gister({ id, colorScheme, tokens })`, applies the persisted selection on
load, and persists state in

`localStorage` (`dsh.vscodeThemes.selected`,
`dsh.vscodeThemes.installed` — JSON array, most recent

first).
- **Host half (`index.js` + `marketplace.js`)** — exposes `search(query)` and
`fetchTheme(e

xt)` on the remote service, delegating to the pure, unit-testable logic
in `marketplace.js` (no Cord

remote service, delegating to the pure, unit-testable logic
in `marketplace.js` (no Cordis wiring).

Search queries the official VS Code Marketplace gallery API (themes category only);
install download

s the theme's `.vsix` from the publisher's `gallery.vsassets.io` CDN,
parses the ZIP in-process, and

reads the theme's JSONC color definitions (which are
stripped of comments/trailing commas before pa

rsing). See PROGRESS.md for the full
protocol facts and edge cases.
## Permissions & external services

- **Outbound network (host half only):**
- `POST https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/_apis/public/g

allery/extensionquery` —
theme search, only when you type a query (2+ characters).
- `GET https://{p

ublisher}.gallery.vsassets.io/…vspackage` — `.vsix` download, only
when you explicitly click Install

.
- **No telemetry, no other network calls.** All parsing and token mapping happens
locally in the h

ost process.
- **Browser state:** `localStorage` only (`dsh.vscodeThemes.*`). Nothing is uploaded.
## Compatibility

- **DSH 0.2.1-alpha.5**, web profile — tested and compatible (the client half is
injected into the W

eb UI).
- **Host half: Node 18+** (uses `DecompressionStream` to unzip `.vsix` files).
- Known limit

ation: marketplace themes without a parseable
`editor.background` / `editor.foreground` are skipped
with a visible error message.
## For developers

`PROGRESS.md` is the project's development log: architecture notes,
marketplace protocol facts, the

critical contracts and pitfalls, and the session log.
It is agent-maintained — read it before changi
ng `client.js` or `marketplace.js`.
### Files
| File | Purpose |

| `index.js` | Host half: `VscodeThemes` remote service (`search` / `fetchTheme`). |
| `client.js` |

Browser half: theme catalog, marketplace search UI, install, persistence, settings UI. |
| `marketp

lace.js` | Pure host logic: marketplace search, vsix fetch/parse, token mapping. |
| `cordis.patch.y

ml` | Inserts the `vscode-themes2` entry into the profile tree. |
| `locale/en.json` | Display title

/description for the Plugin Manager. |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin icon. |
| `screenshots/` | Real-browser

captures embedded in this README. |
| `PROGRESS.md` | Development log & session notes. |
## License
MIT — see the LICENSE file.
